items.jurisdiction: Ohio Secretary of State (statewide program, all 88 county boards of elections)
items.answer_en: Yes, while supplies last. The Ohio Secretary of State sent each of the 88 county boards of elections a limited supply of America 250 "I Voted" stickers for the 2026 general election, for voters who vote in person early or on Election Day.
items.quote: Voters who cast a ballot in person during early voting or on Election Day will receive the commemorative sticker while supplies last.
items.notes: June 12, 2026 release. Direct fetch 403; read from the web.archive.org 2026 copy. Same release: 'Each of Ohio's 88 county boards of elections will receive a limited supply of the new stickers for use during the 2026 General Election.' Says nothing about mail voters.

items.answer_en: In Los Alamos County, the clerk's 2026 student contest picked an "I Voted Early" design along with "I Voted" and "Future Voter," and all three are handed out at every county voting location this year.
items.quote: The three winning designs—one for each key phrase—will be printed and distributed as official stickers at all Los Alamos County voting locations for the 2026 elections.
items.host_label: the Los Alamos County Clerk's Office
items.notes: Contest page (deadline April 14, 2026); key phrases are "I Voted" / "I Voted Early" / "Future Voter". Direct 403; read from Wayback. Contest announcement and plan, not a stock check; 2026 winners page not found. The March 10, 2026 news post (pages3/nm_losalamos.txt, via WebFetch) says the same with 'for the 2026 election year'. The answer contains an em dash only inside the verbatim quote.

items.jurisdiction: Rhode Island Department of State (statewide early voting instructions)
items.answer_en: Yes. The Department of State's early voting steps end with handing back your secrecy folder after the machine scans your ballot, then wearing your "I voted" sticker. Early voting is at your city or town hall.
items.quote: Return the empty secrecy folder to the elections official and proudly wear your “I voted” sticker!
items.host_label: the Rhode Island Department of State
items.notes: Step 5 of 'How to Vote Early Before Election Day'. Live page, undated; direct 403, read from the web.archive.org 2026 copy. Statewide instructions, not one town's practice. Tradition already cites the 2026 handbook's 'Wear your I VOTED sticker!'; this adds the early voting context.

items.jurisdiction: Rhode Island Department of State (statewide mail ballot packet)
items.answer_en: Look in your mail ballot packet. The Department of State lists an "I Voted by Mail" sticker among the packet contents, with the ballot, certificate envelope, instructions and return envelope. If your packet is missing, call the Elections Division at 401-222-2340.
items.host_label: the Rhode Island Department of State
items.notes: List item under 'Your mail ballot packet includes:' (Step 2, Receive Your Mail Ballot). Not a full sentence; the lead-in is 'You will receive your mail ballot packet at the address listed on your application. Your mail ballot packet includes:'. Direct 403; Wayback snapshot 2026-08-25. Page is undated but live.

items.answer_en: For the June 2026 primary, the State Election Board sent limited-edition America 250 "I Voted" stickers to early voting locations and polling places across Oklahoma, while supplies lasted.
items.quote: limited-edition ‘I Voted’ stickers will be available at early voting locations and polling places across the state, while supplies last.
items.notes: Re-checked Oct 24: still only the June 8, 2026 release (June 16 primary). No November release found; the August runoff release and the newsroom index list nothing on stickers. November early voting starts Oct 28, so a release may still come. Use only with the June primary named. Quote is the end of the Secretary's sentence; the page renders 250<sup>th</sup>, so the full sentence does not match stripped text.

items.answer_en: Clark County's 2026 mail ballot tips tell you not to stick the "I Voted" sticker on your ballot. Wear it, and keep it off the ballot and the return envelope.
items.quote: Do not stick the “I Voted” sticker on your ballot.
items.notes: 2026 general mail ballot tips (dates Oct 16, Nov 3, 2026 in the text). Implies a sticker reaches mail voters but never lists packet contents; no Clark page found that says so. 'and the return envelope' in the answer goes past the quote; cut it if QA wants only what the quote says.

items.answer_en: Camden County has its own official "I Voted by Mail" sticker. The county clerk and Board of Elections ran a 2026 student contest for its design, for use in upcoming elections.
items.quote: Winning designs will be featured on official “I Voted” and “I Voted by Mail” stickers distributed to voters in upcoming elections, giving students the opportunity to see their artwork used by thousands of residents throughout Camden County.
items.host_label: the Camden County Clerk's Office and Board of Elections
items.notes: Posted March 16, 2026 (datePublished in page metadata); entries due May 1, 2026. Does not say how mail voters get the sticker (packet or pickup) or that it is in use for Nov 3. Contest page saved as pages3/nj_camden_service.txt (Wayback; live URL 404).

items.notes: In-Person Absentee Voting Site Manual, 'Revised: March 2026' per search title. 403 to curl (with browser headers) and WebFetch; no Wayback copy; Chrome extension not connected. Search snippet says workers 'Offer the Voter an "I Voted Early" sticker' after the ballot is accepted; unverified. city.milwaukee.gov/earlyvoting (Wayback, saved as wi_milwaukee_earlyvoting.txt) has no sticker text. The MPS page in the earlier research is a school district host and does not qualify.

403 to curl and WebFetch, no Wayback copy. The county's 2026 general election page, FAQ and early ballot application (saved) say nothing about stickers.
